summary: Primech Holdings Ltd., a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed facilities services company, furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026 containing responses to shareholder queries ahead of its Annual General Meeting held the same day. Questions from Mr. Zhang Youwei, former Chief Technology Officer of subsidiary Primech AI, centered on the Hytron autonomous cleaning robot, Proposal 11, and ongoing Singapore High Court litigation. The company declined comment on pending proceedings and disclosed Robotic segment revenue of approximately USD 12,000 for FY ended March 31, 2026. No deal, stake, price, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine AGM-related disclosure, not a special situation; watch the litigation and Proposal 11 vote outcome.
